5 a.m., the morning after DevDay
my thumb won't stop scrolling
on the other side of the screen, new features burst
the honest part is my racing heart
workflows shrink, the waiting disappears
before I catch up, the values get repainted
and still, deep in my chest, a noise that won't stop
a map of a race that doesn't know where it's going
not greed but fear, not a dream but an investment
the moment you get off first, the market leaves you behind
giant inertia, spinning on gigawatts
in the roar of the engine, no room to reflect
I can do more and more — so when do I get to rest?
every time I buy speed, I fit the frame
the burdens pushed on me go out on garbage day
a weight I chose adds up to pride
today, what do I let go of, so I can breathe?
a frictionless clean room
never falling, so never sore
never hurt, but the rails never end
what looked like an exit was a flat maze
"which one is your worry?" — a gentle nudge
even the thrill of choosing is a sweet addiction
hide-and-seek for "what only humans can do"
creativity, the power to ask — every hiding place about to be found
as long as I keep comparing, it's a prison with no way out
step off winning and losing, and it's open pasture where the wind blows
but — a handmade aircraft I crashed and fixed
a night it floated up, hope lit in my chest
AI gives the flawless optimum in an instant
mine is covered in scars, but I want to hold it close
an hour of margin that AI freed up
just leaving it empty somehow feels like punishment
I could make one more — a happy miscalculation
before I knew it, that became the quota
the code that was supposed to be wings is now a wheel
what's pushing my back is a culprit with no face
are my choices growing?
or are the demands growing?
the answer is always on my desk
I can do more and more — so when do I get to rest?
every time I buy speed, I fit the frame
the burdens pushed on me go out on garbage day
a weight I chose adds up to pride
today, what do I let go of, so I can breathe?
zero percent juice, but a fruity soda
the sweetness comes from a faraway factory
and still, the first sip makes my heart race
knowing how it works doesn't erase the afterglow
memories of being saved by artificial kindness
doubt too much and that's another poison
not drowning in sweetness, not hating it either
tomorrow, surely, a new release will make my heart pound
and that's fine — I'm in this heat
just one question I won't let go of
in a world where we can do more and more
what can you let go of?
